css.name: --ok-font-family
css.value: "Nunito Variable", "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

css.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

events.description: Tiptap's `beforeCreate`: the editor is being built (the instance doesn't exist yet).
events.name: ok:editor:beforecreate

events.description: Tiptap's `blur`: the focus left the text.
events.name: ok:editor:blur

events.description: After the content changed, with its HTML.
events.name: ok:editor:change

events.description: Tiptap's `contentError`: content didn't fit the editor's schema (with `data-ok-enable-content-check`).
events.name: ok:editor:contenterror

events.description: Tiptap's `create`: the editor is ready, with its HTML.
events.name: ok:editor:create

events.description: Tiptap's `delete`: a node or a mark was removed. `name` is its type (`paragraph`, `bold`…), `from` / `to` the removed range, `partial` when only part of it went.
events.detail: { type: "mark" | "node"; name: string; from: number; to: number; partial: boolean; }
events.name: ok:editor:delete

events.description: Tiptap's `destroy`: the editor was destroyed (the runtime stopped or the element left).
events.name: ok:editor:destroy

events.description: Tiptap's `drop`: content was dropped, with its plain text; `moved` when it was dragged from the editor.
events.detail: { event: DragEvent; text: string; moved: boolean; }
events.name: ok:editor:drop

events.description: Tiptap's `focus`: the focus entered the text.
events.name: ok:editor:focus

events.description: After the editor entered or left full screen.
events.name: ok:editor:fullscreen

events.description: The mention list needs items for `query` (the text after the trigger). `items` holds the matches from `template[data-ok-editor-mention-items]`; call `respondWith(itemsOrPromise)` to show others (for example from a server).
events.detail: { query: string; char: string; items: readonly EditorMentionItem[]; respondWith(items: PromiseLike<readonly EditorMentionItem[]> | readonly EditorMentionItem[]): void; }
events.name: ok:editor:mentionsearch

events.description: Tiptap's `paste`: content was pasted, with its plain text.
events.name: ok:editor:paste

events.description: Tiptap's `selectionUpdate`: the selection moved, from `from` to `to` (document positions).
events.detail: { from: number; to: number; empty: boolean; }
events.name: ok:editor:selectionupdate

events.description: Tiptap's `transaction`: any change of the editor's state; `docChanged` when the content changed.
events.name: ok:editor:transaction

methods.description: The core controller (its `editor` is the Tiptap editor).
methods.name: controller

methods.description: The Tiptap editor: its commands, `on()` for events, `isEmpty`, `isFocused`, `setOptions()`.
methods.name: editor

methods.description: Moves the focus into the editor.
methods.name: focus

methods.description: Whether the editor is in full screen.
methods.name: fullscreen

methods.description: The content as plain text, blocks separated by a blank line.
methods.name: getText

methods.description: Replaces the content with an HTML string (parsed by the browser's `DOMParser`: pages that enforce Trusted Types need a policy for it). Emits no event.
methods.name: setValue

options.description: Every toolbar group: adds code, code block, blockquote, horizontal rule, undo and redo.
options.name: fullItem

options.description: Error state: red border and helper text, `aria-invalid` on the textbox.
options.name: error

options.description: The content can be changed (`false`: read only, toolbar disabled).
options.name: editable

options.description: Tables: the table nodes and the toolbar's table menu (insert, rows, columns, headers, merge, split, delete).
options.name: tables

options.description: Puts the caret in the editor once it is ready: at the `start`, the `end`, or selects `all`. React also takes `true` or a position.
options.name: autofocus

options.description: Text direction of the content: `ltr`, `rtl` or `auto`. Default: inherited.
options.name: textDirection

options.description: Markdown-like shortcuts while typing, such as `# ` for a heading (`false`: off).
options.name: enableInputRules

options.description: The same shortcuts on pasted text (`false`: off).
options.name: enablePasteRules

options.description: Checks content against what the editor supports: invalid content fires a content error event (initial content loads without the invalid parts; a new value is refused).
options.name: enableContentCheck

options.description: Fires the content error event for invalid inserted content even without the check (the content is kept).
options.name: emitContentError

options.description: Form field name: a hidden input holds the HTML value, so the editor submits with its form.
options.name: name

options.description: Fills the viewport (the toolbar's Fullscreen button, Escape leaves).
options.name: fullscreen

options.description: The content: markup inside the content element.
options.name: value

parts.description: On the mention list: its query may hold spaces.
parts.name: data-ok-allow-spaces

parts.description: On the mention list: the character that opens it, such as `@` (default).
parts.name: data-ok-char

parts.description: A toolbar button and the command it runs, such as `bold` (`table`: opens the table menu).
parts.name: data-ok-editor-action

parts.description: A menu item of the heading menu and the block it sets.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-block

parts.description: The scrolling area around the content.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-body

parts.description: The toolbar over selected text: a Popover with `role="toolbar"` and `data-ok-runtime="off"`.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-bubble-menu

parts.description: A code block of the content, with its language menu.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-code-block

parts.description: A field of a toolbar form and what it sets, such as `href`.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-field

parts.description: A toolbar form: the link or the image form.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-form

parts.description: A row of a toolbar form.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-form-row

parts.description: The title of a toolbar form.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-form-title

parts.description: A group of toolbar buttons.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-group

parts.description: The button that opens the heading menu.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-heading

parts.description: The current block's name in the heading button.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-heading-label

parts.description: The helper text under the editor.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-helper

parts.description: One of the full screen button's two icons.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-icon

parts.description: A hidden input holding the HTML value, named for its form (`name`).
parts.name: data-ok-editor-input

parts.description: The language menu of a code block.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-language

parts.description: A mention in the content: `span[data-type="mention"][data-id][data-label]`.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-mention

parts.description: The people (or anything) mentions suggest: a template of `[data-ok-value]` items.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-mention-items

parts.description: An option of the mention list, written by the runtime.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-mention-option

parts.description: The mention list: a Popover with a `[role=listbox]` and `data-ok-runtime="off"`.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-mentions

parts.description: An item of the table menu and the table action it runs, such as `addRowAfter`.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-table-action

parts.description: The toolbar.
parts.name: data-ok-editor-toolbar

parts.description: Marks a toolbar group that only the full toolbar shows.
parts.name: data-ok-full

parts.description: The text shown while the editor is empty.
parts.name: data-ok-placeholder

parts.description: The text transform of a span of content, or of the toolbar's input.
parts.name: data-ok-text-transform

parts.description: On the bubble menu: how long it waits after the selection stops changing (ms; default 250).
parts.name: data-ok-update-delay

parts.description: On a mention template item: the id the mention gets (`data-id`); its text is the label.
parts.name: data-ok-value

react.description: A rich text editor built on Tiptap, through the core editor controller shared with the HTML runtime: a toolbar (heading menu, marks, lists, alignment, code, quote, link, image, undo, fullscreen) over a `contenteditable` textbox.

props.description: Accessible name of the textbox. Default "Editor" when no `aria-labelledby` is given.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Labels the textbox with another element.
props.name: aria-labelledby

props.description: Puts the caret in the editor once it is ready: `"start"`, `"end"`, `"all"`, `true` or a position.
props.name: autofocus

props.description: A toolbar over selected text (`true`: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, link).
props.name: bubbleMenu

props.description: Initial content (HTML) when uncontrolled.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: `false`: read only, the toolbar is disabled.
props.name: editable

props.description: ProseMirror props (Tiptap's `editorProps`), merged with the editor's own. Read at creation.
props.name: editorProps

props.description: Receives the Tiptap editor once it exists, and `null` when it is destroyed: its commands, `getJSON()`, `getText()`, `isEmpty`, `isFocused`, `on()` and `setOptions()`.
props.name: editorRef

props.description: Calls `onContentError` for invalid inserted content even without the check (the content is kept). Read at creation.
props.name: emitContentError

props.description: Checks content against what the editor supports: invalid content calls `onContentError`. The initial content loads without its invalid parts; a new invalid `value` is refused. Read at creation.
props.name: enableContentCheck

props.description: Markdown-like shortcuts while typing, such as `# ` for a heading.
props.name: enableInputRules

props.description: The same shortcuts on pasted text.
props.name: enablePasteRules

props.description: Error state: red border and helper text, `aria-invalid` on the textbox.
props.name: error

props.description: More Tiptap extensions, after the built-in ones (one with a built-in's name replaces it). Read when the editor is created: change the component's `key` to use new ones.
props.name: extensions

props.description: Every toolbar group (code, code block, blockquote, horizontal rule, undo, redo).
props.name: fullItem

props.description: Text under the editor; describes the textbox.
props.name: helperText

props.description: Syntax highlighting and the language menu of code blocks (for example lowlight).
props.name: highlighter

props.description: Mentions: typing `char` (default `@`) opens a list of `items(query)` (may be async); the chosen item becomes `<span data-type="mention" data-id data-label>`. Read when the editor is created.
props.name: mentions

props.description: Form field name: a hidden input holds the HTML value (`""` when empty), so the editor submits with its form.
props.name: name

props.description: Tiptap's `beforeCreate`: the editor is being built.
props.name: onBeforeCreate

props.description: Called with the new HTML (`""` when empty) after every change.
props.name: onChange

props.description: Tiptap's `contentError`: content didn't fit the editor's schema (see `enableContentCheck`).
props.name: onContentError

props.description: Tiptap's `create`: the editor is ready.
props.name: onCreate

props.description: Tiptap's `delete`: a node or a mark was removed.
props.name: onDelete

props.description: Tiptap's `destroy`: the editor was destroyed (unmount, or a new editor for new settings).
props.name: onDestroy

props.description: Tiptap's `blur`: the focus left the text.
props.name: onEditorBlur

props.description: Tiptap's `drop`: content was dropped into the text (`moved` when dragged from the editor).
props.name: onEditorDrop

props.description: Tiptap's `focus`: the focus entered the text (the root's `onFocus` hears every part).
props.name: onEditorFocus

props.description: Tiptap's `paste`: content was pasted into the text, with its ProseMirror `slice`.
props.name: onEditorPaste

props.description: Called when the Fullscreen button or Escape changes fullscreen mode.
props.name: onFullscreenChange

props.description: Tiptap's `selectionUpdate`: the selection moved.
props.name: onSelectionUpdate

props.description: Tiptap's `transaction`: any change of the editor's state.
props.name: onTransaction

props.description: ProseMirror parse options for the content (Tiptap's `parseOptions`). Read at creation.
props.name: parseOptions

props.description: Shown while the editor is empty. ".
props.name: placeholder

props.description: Tables: the table nodes and a table menu in the toolbar.
props.name: tables

props.description: Text direction of the content: `"ltr"`, `"rtl"` or `"auto"`. Default: inherited.
props.name: textDirection

props.description: Controlled content (HTML). `""` is empty.
props.name: value
